title: Listen page in the web app: rate listening-cycle candidates (players, stars, best pick, notes)
description: For the web/docs session (AGENTS.md: web UI is theirs). Design in epic apricitus-2101dd. Data: ListeningCycle (open cycles; options with blind letters A-D, each a fork Score id + audio at files/cycles/<id>/<letter>.m4a), stars as ordinary Ratings on each option's Score, CycleVerdict (cycleId+judge, owner-only: best letter or 'same', per-letter notes, overall note, savedAt). Page: open cycles newest first; one cycle per view; per option a player + stars + note; an explicit best-pick control; Save (upsert; editable until closed). Hide score titles until saved, then reveal which letter was which with links to the scores. Signed-in only; cloud and local modes. Prototype: the Listening Room artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/HV1fa8pRcT9d8hRRcBohuu (its best radio came back null in cycle 1). Blocked by apricitus-80ccff (schema).
